title: Let praise and insult lose their claim
summary: Freedom begins when praise and slander stop moving the center. Let praise and insult pass through the same door.
takeaway: Let praise and insult pass through the same door.
lifeApplication: After praise or criticism lands, wait until the line levels both before you answer from pleasure or pain.
